title: Intersect — Set Intersection
description: Learn to find common elements between two collections using Intersect.

data.text: The `Intersect` extension method requires two collections. It returns a new collection that includes common elements that exist in **both** collections.

data.title: Intersect with Primitive Types
data.content: Finding common elements between two collections

data.text: For complex types, you need to implement `IEqualityComparer<T>`:

data.title: Intersect with Custom Comparer
data.content: Finding common students between two lists

data.title: Not Supported in Query Syntax
data.text: The Intersect operator is not supported in C# or VB.NET query syntax. Use method syntax only.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Intersect returns elements common to both collections
data.takeaway: Continue to the next lesson to learn about the Union operator.
